review.evidence: At Arc block 26080279 (hash 0xd45fba23210a5662823d06f1e292ca0e0798748413f29663b523b30568b955cf; 2026-10-15T10:44:09Z), owner and curator remain the identified EOAs; Morpho's complete role roster has one allocator (the curator) and two sentinels, independently confirmed by role getters and empty controller code. The second sentinel was appointed on 2026-10-14. The selector census confirms seven-day adapter/cap-increase delays, zero-delay fees and force-deallocation penalty, and permanent abdication of three holder-transfer/withdrawal gate setters plus setAdapterRegistry. Runtime SHA-256 over the RPC hex string remains 785aabab2906e799636c4b424bb35c04fd2d74bf35b5dff761b492b3f0afb274, matching the existing exact-deployment execution review; ERC-1967 implementation and beacon slots are zero. Retain the independently reproduced 2026-10-03 functional correspondence to Sourcify VaultV2 reference chain 8453 address 0x91c056b6d4311a743614fbc03ac32d4e6a2d3a3c (solc 0.8.28, viaIR, optimizer 100000): 21808-byte target, compiler-declared asset/decimals/virtualShares immutable masks and 12-byte CBOR tail only, normalized SHA-256 cf17ab0161388ea9277000e692e929216da2618e441c54bcd677def1000dd12e. The one-adapter runtime retains corresponding MorphoMarketV1AdapterV2 reference 0x812b71c33ae5eafebae967c5670e37eca3cab0ac: 11784 bytes, declared factory/parentVault/asset/morpho/adapterId/adaptiveCurveIrm immutable masks plus 12-byte CBOR only, normalized SHA-256 355d973d7a246e5d4c02bb68e7415b9d62bf584a57f6101357b57c5d2fc40113. This is retained historical functional correspondence, not newly asserted complete target creation-metadata verification or financial assurance. Current accounting supports deposit-backed/fee-share minting without arbitrary local supply authority. Exact-key human independence, custody and signing procedures remain scoped questions for each of the four controllers. Local prudential supervision and financial reconciliation are not inherited from Circle.
